entries.land_description: Located on Valley View Lane (off Rt 302). The Highlands Inn is a year round bed and breakfast inn in the beautiful White Mountains.. Located on 100 private, scenic acres, we offer 14 charming rooms, spacious common areas including fireplace living room and library, sunny dining room with piano, and wicker-filled sunporch. The inn has a pool, hot tub and hiking/skiing trails. Tennis, golf, antiquing, hiking and downhill skiing are nearby. housing/permanent structures, plumbing, electricity, woods

entries.land_description: Blueberry Cove, previously a progressive children's camp, is now open summers to adults. We are lesbian owned and run and there is a strong women's energy. We have several workshops for women only, but also workshops for both men and women. People come and vacation here renting cabins or camping. We serve whole food meals and have an organic vegetable garden. Children are welcome but we do not provide child care except during family camp. housing/permanent structures, plumbing, electricity, woods, camping space, women living on the land

entries.land_description: Blueberry Ridge is a women's guesthouse located in the Pocono Mountains of Pennsylvania (Tannersville). It is a beautiful modern house set on 8 acres of woodland with a panoramic view of the Delaware Water Gap. Both the Camelback and Shawnee ski areas can be seen from the spacious redwood deck which runs the length of the house. The activities in this four season vacationland include canoeing the Delaware, hiking, auctions, horseback riding and a host of winter activities. Five rooms are available for rental with breakfast included. The coffee pot is always on and your innkeepers frequently have baked breads and goodies to make your stay more enjoyable. housing/permanent structures, plumbing, electricity, woods
entries.notes: As a general rule, pets are not permitted.

entries.land_description: Beautiful 200-year-old adobe inn on 8 private acres amongst huge cottonwood trees in historic Galisteo. Rates vary from $90-$45 and breakfast is included. There is hot tub, sauna, lap pool, gymnasium and massage available. Smoking is permitted outside only. Only 23 miles from Santa Fe, the Galisteo Basin provides a great space to bicycle, run, hike or horse ride. Informal, yet elegant. housing/permanent structures, plumbing, electricity, farmland, women working on the land

entries.land_description: Begun in 1967, we are now a community of 85 womyn, men and children. We hold non-violence, cooperation, equality and responsibility for the earth as our common values. We grow 50% of our own food, build our own buildings and heat with wood and solar energy. We are economically self-sufficient with our $775,000 hammock and rope furniture business. Womyn and men take on non-traditional jobs and all work is equally distributed.
